title: What If Every Bank Closed For Six Months? #shorts

beats.text: What if every bank in your country closed for six months?
Because in Ireland in nineteen seventy they really did.
The bank workers went on strike and locked every door.
So nobody could take out a single coin of cash.
But people did not panic because they went to the pub.
Eleven thousand pubs turned into banks.
You wrote a cheque and the barman gave you cash because he knew you.
People wrote cheques on any scrap of paper they could find.
And they passed them around like money for six whole months.
When the banks finally opened they found five billion pounds of cheques waiting.
Because the money was never in the bank it was in the trust.
So ask yourself who would still give you cash tomorrow
